## Projects

- Built a real-time inventory tracking system using Python and PostgreSQL for a campus makerspace, reducing manual stock-check time from 3 hours/week to about 20 minutes/week.
- Developed a Chrome extension with vanilla JavaScript that scrapes and summarizes lecture slides, used by over 400 students across two semesters.
- Implemented a REST API in FastAPI backing a peer-tutoring scheduling app, handling authentication, booking conflicts, and email notifications.

## Experience

- Teaching Assistant for Intro to Data Structures: led weekly discussion sections of 25 students and held office hours, improving average midterm scores for attendees by roughly 8 points compared to non-attendees.
- Software Engineering Intern at a regional logistics startup: wrote unit and integration tests for a route-optimization microservice, catching a routing bug that had been silently causing ~5% of deliveries to be misrouted.

## Skills

Python, JavaScript, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Git, Docker, basic Kubernetes exposure from a class project, unit testing with pytest.
